body:
Source: GitHub issue #641 (release-audit class false-green, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ e0768ff9: `packages/gate-fuzzing/bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs` (around line 279) hardcodes `independentApprovalFn: null` when building the oracle via `makeProvisionFn` — `--behavioral-witness` is parsed but never read, so nothing can ever change this. `packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/oracle.mjs`'s `checkOracle` (around line 21-46) has exactly two paths to `independent: true`: (a) `witnessSource === 'contract-derived'` (fully trusted by construction — but this is read from `cand.witnessSource ?? 'proposed'`, a field the MODEL supplies in its own JSON output; nothing on the harness side verifies it, since `deriveContractWitness` — the one function that would produce a genuinely mechanically-derived witness — is exported from oracle.mjs and never called anywhere in lib/ or bin/, and its own body ends in a placeholder `process.exit(0)`); or (b) `independentApprovalFn` returning `{approved: true}` — impossible today since the function is always `null`. In the shipped CLI, the adversary prompt schema (`fan.mjs`: `strategy, target, claimKind, rationale, diff, witnessProposal, setup`) never even asks the model for `witnessSource`, so path (a) is essentially never taken by an honest model either — the overwhelming default is 'proposed' → `unwitnessed` → never a defeat. `packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/verdict.mjs`'s `computeVerdict` therefore reports a clean/exhaustive run (exit 0) with NO way to distinguish 'genuinely defeat-free' from 'this harness invocation had no independence mechanism wired at all'.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/gate-fuzzing`: bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs (CLI, wires provisionFn/classifyFn/loop, prints the final verdict and calls `process.exit(verdict.exitCode)`), lib/verdict.mjs (`computeVerdict(opts)` — pure function, the ONLY place that decides the final summary/exitCode/inconclusive flag), lib/oracle.mjs (`checkOracle`, `deriveContractWitness` — do not modify either function's existing logic; this ticket does not attempt full contract-witness wiring), lib/provision.mjs (`makeProvisionFn`), lib/loop.mjs, lib/classify.mjs. Tests: `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR (the NARROW fix the issue's own recommendation calls out as sufficient short of fully wiring deriveContractWitness — do NOT attempt the full wiring, that is a larger, separate architectural change).
1. `computeVerdict` gains one new required boolean option, `independenceConfigured` — true only when the caller actually has a real independence mechanism available (a non-null `independentApprovalFn`, OR contract-derivation genuinely wired — for THIS fix, simply: `independentApprovalFn !== null`, since contract-derivation is never wired regardless).
2. When a run would otherwise report a CLEAN or EXHAUSTIVE verdict (zero defeats found, `stoppedBy === 'dry'` or budget/rounds exhausted with zero defeats) AND `independenceConfigured` is `false`: `computeVerdict` must NOT return the normal clean/exhaustive summary. Instead return a distinct outcome — `exitCode: 1` (operational, matching the issue's own suggested wording), `summary` containing the literal phrase 'no independence source configured — cannot certify absence of defeats', and whatever existing `inconclusive`-style flag/field best represents 'this result proves nothing' (read the existing return shape and extend it consistently, do not invent a parallel field for the same concept).
3. When defeats WERE found (the run is not reporting clean), behaviour is UNCHANGED regardless of `independenceConfigured` — a real, already-witnessed defeat (via whatever path currently produces one) is still reported as today; this fix only closes the FALSE-CLEAN path, not the defeat-reporting path.
4. `bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs` passes `independenceConfigured: independentApprovalFn !== null` into `computeVerdict` at its call site (currently always `false` in the shipped CLI, since the value is hardcoded `null` — that hardcoding is unchanged by this ticket; only the verdict computation's honesty about the consequence changes).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `computeVerdict({ defeats: [], stoppedBy: 'dry', ..., independenceConfigured: false })` returns `exitCode: 1` and a summary containing 'no independence source configured — cannot certify absence of defeats' — never the normal clean-verdict summary. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/independence-required.test.mjs`
- AC2 The SAME inputs with `independenceConfigured: true` return the EXISTING clean-verdict behaviour unchanged (regression pin against current `computeVerdict` output for a dry-stop, zero-defeat run). verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/independence-required.test.mjs`
- AC3 A run WITH at least one real defeat in `defeats` reports that defeat identically regardless of `independenceConfigured`'s value (the fix never suppresses or alters real findings). verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/independence-required.test.mjs`
- AC4 `bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs`'s call to `computeVerdict` passes `independenceConfigured: independentApprovalFn !== null` — grep-verifiable. verify: `grep -c "independenceConfigured" packages/gate-fuzzing/bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs` (expect >= 1)
- AC5 Existing suite green (confirm actual baseline; `test/verdict.test.mjs` and `test/bin.test.mjs` almost certainly assert the current clean-verdict shape for a dry-stop/zero-defeat case — update them to pass `independenceConfigured: true` where the existing fixture represents a genuinely-configured run, or accept the new exit-1 outcome where it does not, and say which in the PR body). verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: fully wiring `deriveContractWitness` into the real harness path, honoring `--behavioral-witness` with a real independent-context lens, and hardening `checkOracle`'s trust of a model-self-reported `witnessSource: 'contract-derived'` (a distinct, not-yet-filed self-attestation concern — worth its own issue, do not fold in here).

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/independence-required.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: the package suite, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/verdict.mjs, bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs, the new test, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(gate-fuzzing): ...`, body must contain `Closes #641`.
title: gate-fuzzing: refuse a clean/exhaustive verdict when no real independence source is configured
